title: Lobero Theatre

services.name: Rental Event
services.desc: Sing, laugh, and dance with us as we celebrate the 19th year of The Christmas Revels, a joyful celebration of the holidays and the Winter Solstice set in the colorful marketplace and music hall of Victorian England. Enjoy favorite carols, beloved ballads, and heartfelt laments. Clap along to spirited dancing and dazzling footwork. Delight in the theatrics of a traditional mummers’ play and a ghostly melodrama. Share in treasured seasonal traditions with our guest artists, instrumental ensembles, and chorus of all ages. Join us and be joyous!
